comments.author: Adam Danyal
comments.comment: One useful test is whether the agent can explain every failed run from logs alone. If you cannot reconstruct the tool call, retrieved context, model decision, and stop condition, the system is still a demo, not an operational workflow.

comments.author: Alexandru Jalba Cornfeld
comments.comment: Real AI experience starts after the demo, when prompts meet permissions, latency, eval drift, and users who do unexpected things. The people who have shipped through that loop are ahead of most candidates because they know where the neat prototype breaks. What kind of AI work are you hoping to do next, platform, product, or applied ML?
